name: RMA_ASSIGNMENT_V1
inputs: one accepted authorization batch preserving response_ordinal
current unassigned Device Part Units under same SR
steps: sort newly accepted RMAs by preserved response_ordinal
for each RMA load compatible currently unassigned Device Part Units under the request SR ordered by immutable creation_sequence
compatibility requires accepted BOM mapping/equality policy; ambiguity/incompatibility returns unassigned review state rather than forced assignment
choose earliest compatible unassigned target and reserve it for this assignment within the same UnitOfWork
append auto_assign event/current relationship; continue to next RMA
later authorization batches run against remaining current unassigned targets, preserving prior assignments
manual reassignment later changes only assignment relationship/event history
determinism: Given the same accepted batch order and same current eligible target set, assignment is identical; Device display order or UI sorting has no authority.
safety: Assignment never creates receipt, Spare Part Unit, installation, Task outcome or return selection.
